title: Settings
intro: Settings holds only your personal and per-device preferences: Language, On-screen keyboard, Table selection, and Cache. Open Settings with the wrench button at the bottom of the left sidebar after you sign in. Establishment-wide settings live under Manage → General settings (Master role by default).

sections.title: Open Settings
steps: Sign in with a user who can access Settings.
On the left sidebar, tap the wrench button.
The Settings page shows configuration cards in a multi-column layout.
sections.caption: Wrench control that opens Settings (highlighted).

sections.title: Settings overview
sections.intro: Each card on Settings applies to this browser, terminal, or signed-in user — not to the whole venue.
steps: Scroll through the page to find the card you need.
Change values on a card, then save when the card provides a Save action.
For venue-wide controls (profile, currency, print options, closing cycle, session security, and more), open Manage → General settings.
sections.caption: Settings page with personal and device preference cards.

sections.title: Cache
steps: Open the Cache card if menus or related data look stale.
Tap Reload cache to refresh cached catalog data from the database.
sections.caption: Cache reload card.

sections.title: Language and text direction
steps: Select the display language for this device.
Choose LTR or RTL text direction when needed (for example Arabic).
The change applies immediately for this terminal.
sections.caption: Language and direction card.

sections.title: On-screen keyboard
steps: Open the On screen keyboard card.
Toggle enabled/disabled for the virtual keyboard on this device.
sections.caption: On-screen keyboard toggle card.

sections.title: Table selection
sections.intro: When table selection is enabled, staff pick a floor table before ordering (dine-in). When disabled, the floor step is hidden on this terminal (useful for quick service).
steps: Tap the button to enable or disable table selection for this device.
The change applies immediately on this browser.
sections.caption: Table selection hide/show for this terminal.
sections.note: Documentation capture requires table selection enabled (visible floors and tables).
